t: What Abu Bakr was written a page for
a: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشَرَكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا
p: Lā ilāha illā anta rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkah. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa min sharri-sh-shayṭāni wa sharakih, wa an aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sūʾā
m: There is no god but You, Lord of everything and its Owner. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, and from the evil of Satan and his snare, and from bringing harm on myself.
